title: T-4 operator issues a Zero Trust policy via the guide's dashboard walk-through or the alternative API path
asA: operator applying the edge-cloudflare-access v1.0.0 blueprint
iWant: the guide to walk me through issuing the Zero Trust policy on the Cloudflare dashboard AND to document the alternative API path
soThat: the policy issuance flow is unambiguous whether I use the dashboard or the API

acceptanceCriteria.description: The shipped guide/edge-cloudflare-access.md carries a section Zero Trust dashboard walk-through with numbered steps naming each screen; and a section API alternative with a curl example against https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/apps/{app_id}/policies; the vendor URL https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/policies/access/ is cited from ADR-3501 and the guide.
acceptanceCriteria.when: the anatomy test greps for the two section headings, the curl example and the vendor URL
acceptanceCriteria.then: each string matches at least once in the file
